_readme: Spaced-repetition deck. Each lesson lists the card ids it introduces. 'ch' marks Swiss usage. Add cards freely; ids must be unique.

cards.exEn: The referral came by HIN mail.

cards.ex: Die Hausärztin weist den Patienten der Orthopädie zu.
cards.exEn: The GP refers the patient to orthopaedics.
Please inform the GP.
The clinical question is not clear.
The urgency is high.
The secretariat books the appointment.

cards.ex: Der Befund geht an die Zuweiserin.
cards.exEn: The result goes to the referring doctor.
The master data must be correct.
This field is empty.

cards.ex: Ich schreibe es in die Bemerkung.
cards.exEn: I'll write it in the remark.

cards.ex: Es gibt zwei Datensätze für dieselbe Person.
cards.exEn: There are two records for the same person.
Please enter the insurance.

cards.exEn: I have a question about the referral.

cards.ex: Wir bestätigen den Termin per E-Mail.
cards.exEn: We confirm the appointment by email.

cards.exEn: The patient came via the emergency department.

cards.exEn: The interface to the lab is down.

cards.exEn: The discharge letter is in the electronic patient record.

cards.ex: Die Umstellung auf Epic dauert zwei Jahre.
cards.exEn: The switch to Epic takes two years.

cards.ex: Nach der Einführung gibt es Schulungen.
cards.exEn: After go-live there is training.

cards.ex: Wir schicken den Bericht an den Zuweiser.
cards.exEn: We send the report to the referring doctor.

cards.ex: Die Anforderung ist noch nicht klar.
cards.exEn: The requirement is not clear yet.
Every story needs acceptance criteria.

cards.ex: Die Anwender testen das neue System.
cards.exEn: The users test the new system.
I'm checking the invoice.

cards.ex: Unser Ziel sind maximal drei Prozent Rückweisungen.
cards.exEn: Our target is at most three percent rejections.
That is a good improvement.

cards.exEn: The health insurer sent a rejection.

cards.ex: Die Sprechstunde beginnt um acht Uhr.
cards.exEn: The consultation starts at eight.

Bed management plans the admissions.

Utilisation is 85 percent.

No-shows cost capacity.
We have no more capacity.

The bottleneck is anaesthesia.
Do you have your insurance card with you?
The insured number is wrong.
She changed her health insurer.

cards.ex: Die Zusatzversicherung deckt die halbprivate Abteilung.
cards.exEn: The supplementary insurance covers the semi-private ward.

cards.ex: War es ein Unfall oder eine Krankheit?
cards.exEn: Was it an accident or an illness?
Please check your details.

cards.ex: Die grösste Fehlerquelle ist die Aufnahme.
cards.exEn: The biggest source of errors is admission.
The procedure is done as outpatient.
She stays two nights as inpatient.
The procedure takes one hour.

cards.exEn: Without justification the insurer won't pay.

cards.exEn: We send a reminder by SMS.

cards.exEn: I'll align this with the clinic.
Which measure helps most?

cards.ex: Wir setzen das im nächsten Sprint um.
cards.exEn: We'll implement that in the next sprint.
Thanks for the quick feedback.

cards.ex: Die wichtigste Kennzahl ist die Rückweisungsquote.
cards.exEn: The most important KPI is the rejection rate.

cards.ex: Der Auftrag kam mit der Probe.
cards.exEn: The order came with the sample.

cards.ex: Der Befund geht zurück an den Einsender.
cards.exEn: The result goes back to the ordering party.
The sample must be kept cool.
The order form is incomplete.

cards.ex: Das Labor ist rund um die Uhr offen.
cards.exEn: The lab is open around the clock.

cards.ex: Der Rechnungsempfänger ist das andere Spital.
cards.exEn: The invoice recipient is the other hospital.
The AHV number has thirteen digits.
The date of birth is illegible.

cards.ex: Im Spital sagt man in der Schweiz meist Zuweisung.
cards.exEn: In Swiss hospitals people usually say Zuweisung.

cards.ex: Im Hausarztmodell geht man zuerst zur Hausärztin.
cards.exEn: In the GP model you see your GP first.

cards.ex: Die Verlegung ins Kantonsspital ist für morgen geplant.
cards.exEn: The transfer to the cantonal hospital is planned for tomorrow.

cards.ex: Das Spital steht auf der Spitalliste des Kantons.
cards.exEn: The hospital is on the canton's hospital list.

cards.ex: Die Probenannahme ist bis 18 Uhr besetzt.
cards.exEn: Sample reception is staffed until 6 pm.

cards.ex: Der Kurier holt die Proben um 16 Uhr ab.
cards.exEn: The courier picks up the samples at 4 pm.

cards.ex: Wann holen Sie die Proben ab?
cards.exEn: When do you pick up the samples?

cards.ex: Bitte nennen Sie mir die Auftragsnummer.
cards.exEn: Please tell me the order number.
The imaging is on Thursday.

cards.ex: Im Januar gibt es viele Versicherungswechsel.
cards.exEn: In January there are many changes of insurer.

cards.ex: Der Auftrag ist keinem Fall zugeordnet.
cards.exEn: The order is not assigned to any case.
The order is entered twice.

cards.ex: Für diesen Eingriff gilt eine ambulante Pauschale.
cards.exEn: An ambulatory flat rate applies to this procedure.

cards.ex: Der Wiedereintritt war nach zehn Tagen.
cards.exEn: The readmission was after ten days.
Case merging reduces the revenue.
